ratings.comment: Madison is one of the three professors for Bio 151 and when compared to the other two, her lectures are not as engaging. Overall she lectures well, but I found myself spending more time outside of class to understand her topics. The labs also required some outside class hours but the TAs are also helpful to guide you through completing lab reports!
She isn't the best lecturer ever but the content she teaches is fairly interesting.

My favorite lecturer for BIO 151 - she is very passionate about the concepts she covered during her portion of the class. She was slightly disorganized in relaying her thoughts, but she corrected/caught her mistakes.

Uses tophat so you gotta go to lecture. Clearly very passionate about the topics, but a bit unorganized.  Sometimes it felt like she didn't know what she was talking about and was just reading off the slides. A TON of content, way more than the first two units. Exam was decently straightforward, but very small details ended up on the exam.

Dr. Madison's unit was a lot of material, but super interesting. You can tell she is passionate about physiology and it makes lectures more engaging and she can often be funny. She is very organized and clear about what material we are responsible for knowing, which I really appreciated. Overall, I really enjoyed having her!

Her unit definitely contained the most content, but she was great at explaining everything. Her slides were well organized and had lots of visual aids which also helped a lot. If you fill out the learning objectives you'll do well on her exam.

Dr. Madison was very engaging and clearly knows a lot about physiology. Her section was packed with content, however if you enjoy anatomy you will be fine. Discussions help with mastering the content and most of this was review from my hs anatomy class. Her slides weren't always synced with the timeline and LLOs though, which was annoying.

SO much content covered throughout her portion of the course, what was important to know for the exam was not emphasized. She is engaging but I think her portion could be simplified, it felt like I was taking an entire anatomy course in 5 weeks. Put in the time, 5 credits is no joke, and it will pay off.

Dr. Madison has been excellent! She is so much better than Dr. Blair at teaching and is very upbeat in class (unlike Blair haha). She knows a lot about the subject and her personal anecdotes made me understand concepts better. She deserves a higher rating!

I dont understand why so many people dislike Dr. Madison. Her lectures are much more informative to me than Seth Blair's and her slides are very organized unlike Seth's. She is really good at explaining things imo and she doesnt just read off of her slides like people claim. It's important that you remember the diagrams, etc. bc she has a lot.

Prof Madison seems like she may be a professor only so she can pursue research. It's her first year, and she didn't know to repeat questions in lecture so the whole hall can hear. She also misspoke and provided incorrect info sometimes. I'd advise watching crash course anat and reading the textbook to do well on her exam... lol.

Would've had an A if it was Simon or Seth teaching this last section of bio. She was not good at all. Stumbled a lot during lecture, mistakes on the slides and learning objectives. Not sure she was quite confident in what she was teaching

I was doing well in bio until this last section. I know it was her first time teaching here but the exam had so many small details that she mentioned once in lecture. She seemed annoyed during office hours and was defensive when we asked questions.
